subtitle: Lesson 9 · DBA Monitoring with T-SQL

code:
SELECT r.session_id AS blocked_session,
       r.blocking_session_id,
       r.wait_type, r.wait_time,
       r.wait_resource
FROM sys.dm_exec_requests AS r
WHERE r.blocking_session_id <> 0;
caption: blocking_session_id is 0 unless the request is stuck on another session.

eyebrow: Walk the chain to its root
code:
;WITH chain AS (
  SELECT session_id, blocking_session_id, 0 AS depth
  FROM sys.dm_exec_requests
  WHERE blocking_session_id <> 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.session_id, r.blocking_session_id, c.depth+1
  FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r
  JOIN chain c ON r.session_id = c.blocking_session_id
)
SELECT * FROM chain ORDER BY depth DESC;
caption: Recursive CTE follows blocking_session_id back to the root holder.
